title: Psychedelic Forest Ritual
description: A blue-skinned woman in a pink tutu floats upside down in the air with one leg extended high while another identical woman lies on the snowy ground below. A knight in green armor kneels in the snow holding open a large glowing book that emits purple smoke and colorful drips as two bandaged mummies stand among the trees watching.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene in a snowy forest at night. A blue-skinned woman wearing a large pink tutu floats upside down in the air with one leg stretched high. Another identical blue woman lies on the ground nearby. A knight in green armor and helmet kneels in the snow holding open a large glowing book that emits purple smoke and colorful paint drips. Two bandaged mummies stand among the pine trees. The sky shows a swirling galaxy with colorful paint dripping from the top. Paint marks and drips cover the scene.
